    • handleLandedTruckersGoodsLoading

      private ServerEvent handleLandedTruckersGoodsLoading() throws GeneralError
      Initializes the loading phase with the first trucker who landed. If there's at least one good available in the bank, transitions to GOODSTOADD. Otherwise, proceeds with the next trucker or finishes the card effect.
      Returns:
      ServerEvent to send to client
      Throws:
      GeneralError
